h: 发现了这个很酷的工作流程，它允许您使用 4 个参考图像和一个视频来创建很酷的变形视频。 Its a workflow byIpiv唯一的问题是它的帧数设置为 96。虽然可以更改，但需要在 Ipadapter 设置中手动完成和更改大量数学运算。所以，我添加到工作流程中，让这个计算自动完成。

o.en: Found this cool workflow that allowed you to use 4 reference images and a video to create cool morphing videos. Its a workflow byIpivThe only issue was that it had a set frame count of 96.. while it could be changed it needed a lot of math to be manually done and changed inside the Ipadapter settings. So, I added to the workflow to let this calculation be done automatically.
